title: Component structure
instructions:
## Purpose
Review how WorkspacePage composes the Review UI through local components and external component boundaries.

## Regeneration
Run from the scope root:

```sh
pnpm exec tsx src/plugins/artifact-generators/react-component-structure/run.ts \
  --base "." \
  --exclude-component "external:@base-ui/react#*" \
  --exclude-component "external:lucide-react#*" \
  --root "WorkspacePage" \
  "src/client" \
  "src/shared/react-flow" \
  "src/shared/react-ui/button.tsx" \
  "src/shared/react-ui/card.tsx" \
  "src/shared/react-ui/empty.tsx" \
  "src/shared/react-ui/form.tsx" \
  "src/shared/react-ui/tabs.tsx" \
  "src/shared/react-ui/theme-toggle.tsx" \
  "src/shared/react-ui/toggle.tsx"
```

controls.label: data.eyebrow != null || label != null || data.href || anchoredControls.length > 0
